entries.et: Andmestiku versioon 0.1.0: kaheksa panga avaldatud eluasemelaenu tingimused kontrollitud.
entries.en: Dataset version 0.1.0: published housing-loan terms of eight banks checked.

entries.et: Luminori piirkondlik LTV on märgitud tööstusharu siseteabena, mitte panga avaldatud tingimusena: 80% väljaspool Harju ja Tartu maakonda, EIS-iga 90%. Harju ja Tartu maakonna eraldi arvu ei ole.
entries.en: Luminor's regional LTV is labelled as industry insider information, not a term the bank published: 80% outside Harju and Tartu county, 90% with the EIS guarantee. No separate figure for Harju and Tartu county.

entries.et: Bigbanki LTV reeglid on lisatud tööstusharu siseteabena (Sander Seppik, endine Bigbanki eluasemelaenu tiimi liige; Bigbanki lehel avaldamata): tavaline maksimum on tavaliselt 85%; piirkond tavaliselt LTV-d ei muuda; vara seisukord võib LTV-d alandada; ehituslaen algab tavaliselt 50%-st maatüki väärtusest, tõuseb 70%-ni kui hoone on kinni, ja 85%-ni kui hoone on 95% valmis.
entries.en: Bigbank LTV rules were added as industry insider information (Sander Seppik, a former member of Bigbank's housing loan team; not published on Bigbank's website): the usual maximum is usually 85%; region usually does not change the LTV; the condition of the property can lower the LTV; a construction loan starts at usually 50% of the land plot's value, rises to 70% when the building is closed, and to 85% when the building is 95% complete.
